_comment: Reference only. backend_error_alert.sh generates this at runtime with your SERVICE_NAME and notification CHANNEL substituted in. To apply manually: gcloud monitoring policies create --project=YOUR_PROJECT --policy-from-file=this.json (after replacing the placeholders).

documentation.content: A FastAPI backend log entry with severity ERROR or higher was written on Cloud Run. Open Logs Explorer and filter by jsonPayload.chart_key, jsonPayload.request_id, jsonPayload.uid, or jsonPayload.profile_id to trace the failing request end-to-end.
